plurals._: CLDR plural categories. English: one / other. Arabic: zero (0) / one (1) / two (2) / few (n % 100 in 3-10) / many (n % 100 in 11-99) / other. An optional English 'zero' form overrides 'other' for 0. {n} is formatted with Western digits and thousands separators.
